Every measured hot phase has 64 hits and zero leaders; a direct reference encoder GPU speedup cannot explain hot contrasts.
limited: Cold B throughput gains accompany shorter observed service latency but are not isolated from generation length, scheduling or instrumentation.

postfix.inference_scope: Two paired server replicates only. Hot repeats are not independent replicates. Engineering guards are not statistical non-inferiority, a confidence interval, or a causal-effect estimate.
postfix.runtime_fix_scope: Runtime stream-isolation fix addresses memory behavior; it is not evidence that hot latency is solved.
